title: The finite-level twist is the displayed constant-ring scalar extension.
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme, let $\ell$ be prime, fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, and let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite intermediate extension. Write $O_E$ for its ring of integers with the topology restricted from the fixed algebraic closure [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Work on the small pro-etale site of $X$, small relative to abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $n\geq0$, put $N=\ell^{n+1}$ and $B=O_E/(N)$, with the discrete topology. Write $\widetilde B=\operatorname{ULift}(B)$ for the universe lift used in constant coefficient sheaves. Let $C=p_X^*\underline B$ and $R=p_X^*\underline{O_E}$ be the pulled-back continuous-function ring objects [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], with $\rho:R\to C$ induced by reduction. Let $M=\mu_{N,X}$ be the actual roots-of-unity abelian sheaf with its specified constant $(\mathbf Z/N)_X$-action [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf].

In the tensor category of abelian sheaves [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-structure], let $F_C(M)$ denote the internal $C$-module with underlying object $C\otimes_{\mathbf Z}M$ and action given by multiplication on the first factor [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. The native integral level is $Q_{E,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{\rho}F_C(M)$, namely the construction `spIntegralTwistLevel X ℓ E n`. For a unital map $a:\mathbf Z/N\to\widetilde B$, let $L_a=\widetilde B_X\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_X}M$ be the finite Tate line [def-pur-finite-tate-line-signed-comparison], namely `Scheme.tateFiniteLine X ℓ (ULift B) n a`.

There exists a unital ring map $a:\mathbf Z/N\to\widetilde B$ and an isomorphism of abelian sheaves
$$U(Q_{E,n})\cong U(L_a),$$
where $U$ forgets the respective coefficient actions. No invertibility assumption on $\ell$ on $X$ is needed.

proof.text: The generator ell^(n+1) lies in the ideal defining B=O_E/(ell^(n+1)); therefore its image is zero in B and in ULift B. The usual ZMod cast homomorphism gives the required a:ZMod(ell^(n+1))->ULift B. Equip B with the discrete topology; its finiteness is spEllQuotient_finite_continuous, with no invertibility assumption on X.

Apply finiteDiscreteCondensedRing_constant to B, then finiteDiscreteSchemeRing_constant to its ring-object isomorphism. This identifies the underlying pulled-back finite coefficient sheaf with the constant additive sheaf of ULift B on X. Tensor the inverse coefficient identification with the identity of the actual roots-of-unity sheaf.

Apply constantZMod_scalarTensor to the actual root module and a. It identifies the constant ULift B sheaf tensored over the integers with the underlying root sheaf with the underlying ordinary scalar extension along a, which is by definition tateFiniteLine. Compose with the tensor isomorphism of the preceding step. Restriction of scalars in spIntegralTwistLevel changes only the action, so its underlying object is definitionally the source of this composite. This constructs the requested a and isomorphism directly.

theorem spIntegralTwistLevel_comparison (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) →+* ULift.{u + 1} (spEllQuotient ℓ E n),

        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
          (Scheme.tateFiniteLine X ℓ (ULift.{u + 1} (spEllQuotient ℓ E n)) n a)) := by
